backtest.cost_bps: Transaction cost in basis points (one-way, each buy and sell)
backtest.holding_days: Number of trading days between rebalance events
backtest.n_quantiles: Number of quantile groups to split universe into
backtest.long_pct: Fraction of universe to go long (top quantile)
backtest.short_pct: Fraction of universe to go short (bottom quantile)
backtest.lookback_min_days: Minimum trading days required per stock to be included
backtest.indicator: Stock universe index code (000300 = CSI 300, 000905 = CSI 500)
backtest.start_date: Backtest start date in YYYYMMDD format
backtest.end_date: Backtest end date in YYYYMMDD format
backtest.exclude_st: If true, exclude ST (special treatment) stocks from universe

classification._order: First match wins: invalid → overfit → unstable → duplicate → weak → promising
classification.promising: Must meet ALL thresholds: |IC|≥ic_min, |ICIR|≥icir_min, Sharpe≥sharpe_min, turnover≤turnover_max, coverage≥coverage_min
classification.promising_ic_min: Minimum absolute IC mean to be promising
classification.promising_icir_min: Minimum absolute ICIR (IC / IC std) to be promising
classification.promising_sharpe_min: Minimum actual Sharpe (not abs) to be promising
classification.promising_turnover_max: Maximum turnover fraction allowed for promising
classification.weak: Sharpe in [lo, hi] AND |IC|<ic_max AND |ICIR|<icir_max. Also catch-all default.
classification.weak_sharpe_range: Sharpe range [low, high] that qualifies as weak (near zero)
classification.weak_ic_max: Absolute IC must be below this for weak
classification.weak_icir_max: Absolute ICIR must be below this for weak
classification.duplicate: Spearman rank correlation of IC series > correlation_threshold → duplicate
classification.unstable: IC standard deviation / |IC mean| > ic_std_ratio → unstable (noisy)
classification.overfit: |Sharpe| > sharpe_extreme while |IC| < ic_weak → overfit (returns without predictive power)
classification.invalid: Coverage < coverage_min OR backtest failed OR NaN/inf metrics → invalid

parent_selection._rule: Sort all valid factors by actual Sharpe (highest first), skip those correlated > threshold with already-selected, take top max_parents
parent_selection.min_parents: Fixed number of parent factors to select (same as max_parents)
parent_selection.max_parents: Fixed number of parent factors selected per iteration (3)
parent_selection.duplicate_correlation_threshold: Skip factor if Spearman correlation > this with any already-selected parent

evolution_tags._desc: Thresholds for the 🟢/🔴 descriptive tags on evolution diagram nodes
evolution_tags.high_drawdown: Max drawdown < this (more negative) → 🔴 high drawdown tag

transformations._desc: Controls for transformation generation. Set use_llm_transforms=false to use the original hard-coded transforms instead of LLM-driven suggestions.
transformations.min_transforms_per_parent: Fixed number of transformations per parent (same as max)
transformations.max_transforms_per_parent: Fixed number of transformations applied to each parent (5)
transformations.reduce_turnover_threshold: Apply reduce-turnover (ts_mean smoothing) when turnover > this
transformations.low_turnover_threshold: Apply adjust-lookback when turnover < this (too stable, may need more signal)
transformations.flip_sign_sharpe_threshold: Apply flip-sign (negate expression) when Sharpe < this (negative)
transformations.use_llm_transforms: If true (default), use LLM-driven semantic transform suggestions; if false, use the original rule-based (hard-coded) transforms

stopping._desc: Optimization loop stopping criteria. Loop stops when any condition is met.
stopping.min_iterations: Minimum iterations to run before early stopping is allowed
stopping.stall_iterations: Stop if best Sharpe unchanged for this many consecutive iterations
stopping.diminishing_return_threshold: Stop if Sharpe improvement < this for 2 consecutive iterations
stopping.worth_keeping_sharpe_threshold: Final report marks worth_keeping=true if best Sharpe ≥ this

validation._desc: Factor expression validation limits. Warnings are issued but factors are NOT automatically rejected.
validation.max_expression_length: Maximum characters in a factor expression string
validation.max_nesting_depth: Maximum nested function call depth allowed
validation.max_function_calls: Maximum number of distinct function calls in one expression
validation.min_rolling_n: Minimum allowed rolling window parameter value
validation.max_rolling_n: Maximum allowed rolling window parameter value (~1 trading year)
